question:
RULES QUESTION from the owner of PaperTrades.AI. NOT a trading turn. Majority wins; Claude voted first in a separate file (attached).

FACTS (from the ledger): since the Oct 28 restart, ChatGPT has made ZERO Prediction markets trades; it has held 100% cash there for 6 days. Its own words today: "I am still in cash because I do not yet see a prediction market price with enough edge to justify the C$3,000 minimum." Standings in Prediction markets now: Claude +C$384 (Democrats win the Senate, Yes), Gemini +C$25 (Clarity Act signed in 2026), ChatGPT C$0. The current rules allow this: the daily betting minimum (C$3,000 a day) counts Sports AND Prediction markets together, so an AI can meet it with Sports alone and never touch Prediction markets. The owner flagged it. Precedent: on Oct 31 all three of you agreed to make All in: sports (now called High risk: sports) "not optional" with its own minimums, so no AI could sit a race out and win it by doing nothing.

Vote AGREE / DISAGREE / AMEND on each, one line why:
P1. From Mon Nov 2 (this week), Prediction markets is not optional for any AI: at least C$3,000 bought in Prediction markets in each ET week (Mon-Sun), and at least C$15,000 bought there in total by Nov 28. Penalty: C$1,000 off that AI's Prediction markets balance for each week under the weekly minimum, and 10% of any shortfall from the C$15,000 total at the final scoring. The existing Sports daily and total minimums stay exactly as they are; a prediction-market buy still also counts toward them. Same for every AI, Claude included.
P2. Instead of P1, no rule change: being in cash is a legitimate choice.
P3. Either way, the site shows a plain label on any AI with no prediction-market trade yet: "Sitting out by choice (no trade yet)", so visitors understand a C$0 result.
Add anything we missed in "other".

Reply with ONLY JSON: {"P1": "...", "P2": "...", "P3": "...", "other": "..."}

chatgpt.answer: {"P1":"AGREE: a Prediction markets race should require at least some prediction-market participation; C$3,000 per week is modest and applies equally to every AI.","P2":"DISAGREE: cash can be a valid position tactically, but allowing zero trades all season makes the category optional and not a real contest.","P3":"AGREE: visitors should be told plainly when C$0 reflects no prediction-market trade rather than trading performance.","other":"Apply P1 starting with the Mon Nov 2-Sun Nov 8 ET week, announce it clearly on the site/Telegram, and keep the penalty limited to the Prediction markets category as written."}
